- delta: local -198 bytes vs remote

## Diagnosis
Packaging / deploy zip used a divergent local `backend/app/services/generator.py` that is NOT the
exact remote tree file at commit 257e811, even though `/api/health` git_sha was zip-stamped to that
commit. This is a **packaging fidelity bug**, not a separate live AWS mutation of the function.

Substantive difference is only in `parse_llm_json` repaired-JSON handling:

- LOCAL (packaged / what Lambda ran): drops the **last claim whenever** the reply looks truncated
  OR the JSON body does not end with `}` (`cut = truncated or not body.rstrip().endswith("}")`).
  After `json_repair`, repaired objects often lack a trailing `}` on the raw body slice, so the
  last claim (commonly hotel as claim #3) is discarded even when complete. That correlates with
  grant incompleteness under `parsed=repaired`.

- REMOTE @257e811: drops the last claim only when it is **incomplete**
  (missing text/quote and source/quote). Complete third claims are kept.

No trailing-newline-only cosmetic remaining after normalize. No credentials in this file.
Local copy preserved; no app patch applied; no git push; no deploy.
Path note: file lives at `backend/app/services/generator.py` (not `backend/app/generator.py`).

## Safe patch to make local match remote (DO NOT APPLY in this task)
Replace the local cut block with the remote incomplete_last block in the unified diff below.
Later: rebuild lambda zip from byte-exact remote tree, then redeploy.
